title: Marketplace listing for [product]
description: Create a complete marketplace listing for [product, condition, key specs]: title optimized for search, bullet highlights, description, and pricing rationale vs comparable listings. Platform: [eBay/Amazon/Kleinanzeigen…].

name: 📣 Social post
title: Social post: [topic] for [platform]
description: Write a platform-native post about [topic] for [platform]. Goal: [engagement/signups/awareness]. Include hook, body, CTA, and 2 alternative hooks. Match STYLE-VOICE.

name: 🔎 Research question
title: Research: [question]
description: Research [question] thoroughly: current state, key players/options, numbers where available, and a clear recommendation with reasoning. Cite sources. End with the 3 most decision-relevant findings.

name: 🎧 DJ set plan
title: DJ set plan: [event/venue/slot]
description: Plan a [length]-minute DJ set for [event/venue, crowd, time slot]. Include energy arc, 3-4 phases with genre/BPM ranges, anchor tracks per phase, transition notes, and 2 backup directions if the floor doesn't respond.

name: 🧬 Onboard a code repository
title: Onboard repo: [repo name] — generate AGENTS.md
description: READ-ONLY onboarding of the repository this task is attached to (set the task's repo field!). Explore the codebase by symbol (mcp-serena) and produce/refresh AGENTS.md at the repo root with, in this order: 1) one-paragraph purpose; 2) architecture map (top-level dirs -> responsibility, key entry points); 3) exact commands: test, build, lint, run (verify each actually works and paste real output in the deliverable); 4) conventions (naming, error handling, patterns to follow/avoid — derived from the code, not invented); 5) danger zones (fragile modules, migrations, generated files not to touch). KEEP IT UNDER 150 LINES — ruthless concision; agents ignore bloated conventions files. Do not change any other file. Commit AGENTS.md on the branch.
